human.problem: Two wrong answers here, 'Hearing the cry of the poor' and 'Watching over the nations,' are things God really does later in this passage (Job 34:28-29). 'Watches over man and nation' is the right answer on stop 2 card 9. A baker taught here that 'watching over the nations' is the wrong pick may be confused later.
